description:
A Java connector for a celld or Workers deployment its team cannot change
    (srad/agentspaces-js.md JS-C-09): an operator's manifest of allowlisted
    Worker routes becomes workers:// AssetCards on agentspaces-connect-core,
    GET routes answer aspace:cap/data-query, POST routes answer
    aspace:cap/asset-invoke, and every call goes over HTTPS with the
    operator's bearer or mTLS credential and the invocation id as a header.
